notes.subject: fix(linux): drop macOS node-pty from Linux VSIXs and require Secret Service

notes.subject: feat(cli): ship Linux x64 and arm64 builds with environment API keys for headless hosts

notes.subject: feat(terminal): enable the Native Agent terminal on Linux
notes.summary: Local glibc Linux hosts now run approved agent commands in the AgentLink terminal when the VSIX includes the node-pty prebuild, honouring the Linux terminal profile and env settings.

notes.subject: feat(sandbox): add a bubblewrap backend for Linux, not yet enabled
notes.summary: The sandbox helper and @agentlink/sandbox gain a bubblewrap backend for Linux x64/arm64 with a prerequisites checker, though no AgentLink surface routes to it yet.

notes.subject: feat(sandbox): run sandboxed agent commands under bubblewrap on Linux

notes.subject: feat(desktop): build and run AgentLink Desktop on Linux as an AppImage

notes.subject: feat(desktop): ship a Linux deb with an AppArmor profile and build Linux Desktop in CI

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): network access and Mac-only escalation for granted-folder commands

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): background commands in folders granted for commands

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): edit files without asking in folders approved on a card
notes.summary: Approving a folder for commands in Ask Agent now also lets the agent create and edit files there without a card, with a per-folder "Edit files without asking" toggle in Manage access.

notes.subject: feat(ask-agent): Approve for Me toggle in the composer

notes.subject: feat(chat): reveal the terminal a completed command ran in
notes.summary: Clicking a finished execute_command in the transcript now focuses the terminal it ran in if still open, or shows a notice if it has closed.

notes.subject: feat(agent): prompt foreground agents to recall earlier sessions
notes.summary: Foreground agents are now prompted to recall earlier sessions via session search tools when the user refers to prior work not visible in the current conversation.

notes.subject: feat: add frozen work summaries to final status cards
notes.summary: Final status cards in VS Code now include a frozen Work summary with per-file rows and expandable read-only diffs, also served on demand to browser and Desktop remote views and exposed as new protocol types.

notes.subject: test(retrieval): give LanceDB contract tests a load-tolerant timeout
notes.summary: Test-only change giving the LanceDB retrieval contract tests a longer timeout under load; no shipped behaviour changes.

notes.subject: feat: make work summary cards collapsible
notes.summary: The Work summary card can now be collapsed to a header that still shows the file and line totals inline.

notes.subject: fix(chat): mark the chat tab that owns a pending question
notes.summary: Chat tabs now show Needs input when they own a pending question or approval, including restored questions and ones raised by background agents, and the VS Code and browser tab lists refresh when that changes.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): recover Ask Agent's saved model when the first snapshot is lost
notes.summary: Ask Agent in Desktop and Browser now recovers its saved chat, model and thinking level when the first snapshot is lost, instead of staying on the placeholder model, and logs rejected snapshots and recovery attempts.

notes.subject: feat(agent): trim duplicated reasoning prompt rules and defer MCP resource tools
notes.summary: Trims duplicated reasoning prompt rules and defers the MCP resource and prompt tools behind find_native_tools, which reduces prompt size while find_mcp_tools and call_mcp_tool stay directly available.

notes.subject: feat(evals): add a live first-turn routing eval with golden tasks
notes.summary: Adds a developer-only live first-turn routing eval (npm run eval:routing) with golden tasks; it is not shipped to users.

notes.subject: fix(agent): let call_native_tool invoke deferred MCP resource and prompt tools
notes.summary: Fixes deferred MCP resource and prompt tools (list/read resources, list/get prompts) so they can actually be invoked through call_native_tool instead of being discoverable but uninvocable.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): keep the inline transcript indicator instead of the pinned bar
notes.summary: Ask Agent now shows live activity inside the streaming reply and no longer shows the pinned status bar above the composer, avoiding duplicate indicators.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): keep Approve for Me on, approve open cards, restyle toggle
notes.summary: Ask Agent keeps Approve for Me shown as on during live updates, approves an open command or edit card when it is turned on, and restyles the active composer toggle with a soft accent tint.

notes.subject: feat(chat): offer yes/no cards when a turn ends without set_task_status
notes.summary: Chat now offers yes/no answer cards for trailing direct questions when a live turn ends without a set_task_status marker, in both the VS Code webview and the browser projection.

notes.subject: fix(agent): accept deferred MCP bridges on the pre-resolved native tool path
notes.summary: Fixes deferred MCP bridge tools like list_mcp_resources failing with invalid_resolved_native_tool when called through the pre-resolved native tool path in live sessions.

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): run dev servers sandboxed and auto-approve new folders with Approve for Me
notes.summary: Ask Agent dev servers now run inside the macOS sandbox with local port binding, and Approve for Me auto-approves new empty folders under ~/AgentLink; the sandbox launcher gains an additive allowLocalBinding option.</br>

notes.subject: test(agent): require a call_native_tool validator for every deferred native tool

notes.subject: fix(webview): only stop following the transcript on real user scroll input

notes.subject: fix(ask-agent): resume streaming when switching back to a chat with a running turn
notes.summary: Switching back to an Ask Agent chat whose turn is still running now resumes the live streaming activity indicator instead of dropping it.

notes.subject: feat(final-status): show ask duration on the final status card
notes.summary: The final status card header now shows how long the ask took (e.g. Task complete · 4m 12s), in VS Code and browser chat, and the field is added to the protocol.

notes.subject: feat(cli): pass messages sent mid-turn into the running turn

notes.summary: System prompt guidance and the built-in agent modes move into @agentlink/core as new system-prompt and agent-modes entry points; VS Code's prompts are unchanged.

notes.subject: feat(cli): lead the CLI prompt with VS Code's shared guidance
notes.summary: The CLI's system prompt now leads with VS Code's shared guidance for the tools each session registers. workspace-host gains an opt-in sharedPromptGuidance option.

notes.subject: feat(cli): add agent modes with /mode
notes.summary: The CLI gets VS Code's agent modes with /mode and /mode SLUG, saved per session, with custom modes from modes.json. workspace-host gains a modes option and core gains session modes.

notes.subject: feat(assistant): layer the prompt on VS Code's shared guidance
notes.summary: The Assistant's prompts now build on VS Code's shared guidance for the tools each chat has, as a general assistant for owner chats. workspace-host's sharedPromptGuidance also accepts a codingAssistant option.

notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): give execute_command VS Code's input and result
notes.summary: execute_command in the CLI and Assistant now takes VS Code's parameters (timeout in seconds, env, output filters) and returns VS Code's result fields. Older timeoutMs calls still run. The output filter moves to @agentlink/core/command-output.

notes.subject: fix(core): build the command-output subpath for CommonJS
notes.summary: Fixes the CommonJS build so the @agentlink/core command-output subpath is included.

notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): replace command output tools with get_terminal_output and close_terminals
notes.summary: workspace-host replaces get_command_output, list_commands and stop_command with VS Code's get_terminal_output and close_terminals. Ask Agent's execute_command moves to VS Code's schema, and the CLI, Assistant and Ask Agent use the new tools.

notes.subject: feat(cli,assistant): run read-only commands in Ask mode and for task reviewers
notes.summary: CLI Ask mode and Assistant task reviewers can now run commands that VS Code's read-only check clears without asking, with other commands prompting (CLI) or refused (reviewers); the classifier is shared via new core subpaths.

notes.subject: feat(cli): let the model propose mode changes with switch_mode and ask_user modeSwitch
notes.summary: The CLI model can now propose mode changes with switch_mode and ask_user modeSwitch, shown as an Allow/Reject card, with the turn continuing in the new mode.

notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): use VS Code's background agent management tools
notes.summary: CLI and Assistant background agent tools now use VS Code's descriptions, inputs and results, name children by sessionId, and can wait for any or all of several children.

notes.subject: feat(workspace-host): spawn background agents with VS Code's ownedPaths
notes.summary: CLI and Assistant spawn_background_agent now takes VS Code's ownedPaths and forbiddenPaths with ownership handoff, optional read_paths, and a configurable per-session child limit (4 in CLI, 2 in Assistant).

notes.subject: fix(sandbox): follow agent-folder skill symlinks and type namespace rejections
notes.summary: Sandboxed commands no longer fail when an agent-folder skill symlink such as .agents/skills -> ../.claude/skills points into another policy folder; other namespace rejections now report the offending path.

notes.subject: fix(codex): stream Responses tool argument deltas keyed by item_id
notes.summary: Fixes Responses API tool argument streaming so long tool calls no longer trip the no-progress watchdog and retry repeatedly; repeated no-progress timeouts now surface after one retry.

notes.subject: fix(agent): start a todo list for multi-step work on every prompt profile
notes.summary: The system prompt and todo_write description now tell the model to start a todo list in its first response for multi-step work on every prompt profile, restoring todo use with the compact profile.

notes.subject: fix(tools): follow stale built-in skill paths to the current catalog entry
notes.summary: load_skill now follows a stale built-in skill path left after an extension update to the current built-in catalog entry instead of failing.

notes.subject: feat(browser-gateway): improve mobile and foldable layout
notes.summary: Improves the browser gateway on phones and foldables: chats no longer jump to the bottom, a 600px phone breakpoint, denser touch type, VS Code chat tabs in the shell sidebar, a tab close endpoint, and the VS Code view reopens after reload.

notes.subject: fix(tools): reject ${digits} references in find_and_replace regex templates
notes.summary: find_and_replace in regex mode now rejects ${N} references with a clear error before any edit instead of silently inserting the literal text and dropping the captured content.

notes.subject: feat(background): replace automatic fleet budgets with foreground-led progress supervision
notes.summary: Background agents no longer get automatic budgets or wrap-up messages; the foreground coordinator judges progress through status and progress-check steering, and explicit budgets only stop a run at their hard boundary.

notes.subject: fix(skills): let load_skill activate readable skills missing from the catalog
notes.summary: load_skill can now activate a readable SKILL.md missing from or newer than the session catalog, such as a freshly pulled skill or one in a second workspace folder, while keeping disabled skills disabled and applying allowed-tools restrictions.

notes.subject: feat(worktree): create worktrees for every repo in multi-root workspaces

notes.subject: fix(codex): name the real cause in Responses retry warnings
notes.summary: Codex retry warnings now name the real cause (such as overloaded 503), retry number, delay and next transport instead of a generic 'Response interrupted' message; retry behavior is unchanged.

notes.subject: fix(indexer): optimize retrieval store during long indexing jobs
notes.summary: The indexer now optimizes the retrieval store between committed batches during long indexing jobs, preventing runaway storage growth and stalls, and reports optimization failures as non-fatal errors.

notes.subject: feat(indexer): add Free Up Space to the codebase index sidebar
notes.summary: Adds a Free Up Space button and agentlink.maintainIndex command that compact the workspace's codebase index and prune old database history without re-indexing, reporting the space reclaimed.

notes.subject: fix(retrieval): give store optimization a one-hour lock limit
notes.summary: Retrieval store compaction and pruning now get a one-hour lock limit so optimizing a heavily bloated index no longer times out and leaves the store locked and bloated.

notes.subject: fix(indexer): report store space reclaimed as measured on disk
notes.summary: Index optimization now reports space reclaimed as measured on disk, rather than Lance's prune statistics that omitted old manifests and showed 0 MiB, and logs the store size afterward.

notes.subject: fix(plugins): stop liveness-only registry bumps from reconnecting MCP in every window
notes.summary: Plugin registry changes that only reflect other windows opening or closing no longer make every VS Code window reconnect its MCP servers.

notes.subject: fix(agent): show text results in final status cards
notes.summary: Final status cards now show a text result as the summary when set_task_status provides no summary.

notes.subject: feat(chat): expose final results and continuation prompts

notes.subject: fix(chat): preserve protocol boundaries and clarify stale results
notes.summary: The stale-result error for browser final results now says it is waiting for an updated session snapshot instead of suggesting a retry.

notes.subject: fix(chat): hide default continuation text and restore bottom-left action
notes.summary: Final status cards hide the built-in default continuation text and show the Continue action at the bottom-left, displaying a Next step prompt only when the agent supplies one.

notes.subject: fix(codex): stop the no-progress watchdog restarting silent reasoning
notes.summary: Long silent Codex reasoning is no longer mistaken for a dead stream and restarted by the no-progress watchdog; a bounded 30-minute window now applies while reasoning is open.

notes.subject: fix: harden tool diagnostics and background recovery
notes.summary: Hardens tool diagnostics and recovery: bounded MCP crash reconnects with config revalidation, preserved evidence for failed background agents, safe command and sandbox diagnostics, bounded xxd/dyld_info reads, web fetch provenance, quiet update polling, and accurate failed-save reporting.

notes.subject: fix(tools): make read-only network and web-fetch failures actionable
notes.summary: Read-only network rejections now tell background agents to ask the coordinator for the exact remote data, Codex page-access failures report a bounded cause, and dyld_info accepts bare usage and Apple system image inspection on macOS.

notes.subject: fix(edit): keep preserving saves out of non-primary editor groups
notes.summary: Saves without formatting now close the temporary tab they open in a non-primary editor group so agent-edited files stay in the left column.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): let bridge restarts finish so browser approvals land
notes.summary: Browser gateway restarts now finish by closing open connections, so browser approvals no longer fail with 502, and approval failures are shown next to the approval card.

notes.subject: fix(tools): allow dyld_info on shared-cache system images
notes.summary: The read-only classifier now allows dyld_info on macOS system images that exist only in the dyld shared cache, accepting missing paths only inside Apple system image roots.

notes.summary: Adds an Agent activity UX guide to the bundled documentation and corrects the embedding guide about thinking events being forwarded by the Web transport.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): keep browser-queued messages and share Auto Continue
notes.summary: Browser-queued and interjected messages now survive VS Code tab switches and work on unfocused chat tabs, and Auto Continue is now a per-chat setting run by VS Code and shared between VS Code and the browser.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): drain heartbeats before releasing owner leases
notes.summary: Fixes a race where a late heartbeat could reconnect the browser gateway owner after its lease had been released.

c5f5f5ee42dc78f5188fae29b547a6dc02cbc74e.summary: Host tools can end a turn, and the CLI and Assistant gain VS Code's set_task_status with a final card, restore on reload, Ctrl+N continue in the CLI, and Auto Continue stopping in the Assistant.

1d3e2af57ad2d931d0b742920f7348a84dcd2fae.summary: Messages sent while a CLI turn is running are now taken into that turn at its next break instead of running afterwards, and the footer shows a ^n continue hint when a continue action is available.

cce375bed0c93512570ea187c118e8816423fc1c.summary: System prompt guidance and the built-in agent modes move into @agentlink/core as new system-prompt and agent-modes entry points; VS Code's prompts are unchanged.

f6732ce7fbe048a52b6b3d78d3caa184844430ba.summary: The CLI's system prompt now leads with VS Code's shared guidance for the tools each session registers. workspace-host gains an opt-in sharedPromptGuidance option.

d3947361cdb2adeb3c010298b871d994cec12f07.summary: The CLI gets VS Code's agent modes with /mode and /mode SLUG, saved per session, with custom modes from modes.json. workspace-host gains a modes option and core gains session modes.

908f8a1e3131405d0d64910e655f0d61f48b723b.summary: The Assistant's prompts now build on VS Code's shared guidance for the tools each chat has, as a general assistant for owner chats. workspace-host's sharedPromptGuidance also accepts a codingAssistant option.

997df9834983735a6ed10f99ee98ab51b5f24861.summary: execute_command in the CLI and Assistant now takes VS Code's parameters (timeout in seconds, env, output filters) and returns VS Code's result fields. Older timeoutMs calls still run. The output filter moves to @agentlink/core/command-output.

79c837fdac14dd4e2987342749b0114e65667792.summary: Fixes the CommonJS build so the @agentlink/core command-output subpath is included.

c27ebbfb8e79942f1941337a0ab42d57715989be.summary: workspace-host replaces get_command_output, list_commands and stop_command with VS Code's get_terminal_output and close_terminals. Ask Agent's execute_command moves to VS Code's schema, and the CLI, Assistant and Ask Agent use the new tools.

73cd67552780aeb81b26b4debced936cfa2b5c08.summary: CLI Ask mode and Assistant task reviewers can now run commands that VS Code's read-only check clears without asking, with other commands prompting (CLI) or refused (reviewers); the classifier is shared via new core subpaths.

be8d14028d3ada2faa7f89b2bf55742edf30b894.summary: The CLI model can now propose mode changes with switch_mode and ask_user modeSwitch, shown as an Allow/Reject card, with the turn continuing in the new mode.

e34267c7a3f965fa78a70970c7d443619377cba6.summary: CLI and Assistant background agent tools now use VS Code's descriptions, inputs and results, name children by sessionId, and can wait for any or all of several children.

fe9d9f1c9cbcc42b7399c9876e35ff57f88c7536.summary: CLI and Assistant spawn_background_agent now takes VS Code's ownedPaths and forbiddenPaths with ownership handoff, optional read_paths, and a configurable per-session child limit (4 in CLI, 2 in Assistant).

a3b4a544046be6d157c82912f6c608cb4618267c.summary: Sandboxed commands no longer fail when an agent-folder skill symlink such as .agents/skills -> ../.claude/skills points into another policy folder; other namespace rejections now report the offending path.

849207f4851c531ed6dd012393837e5838f758b3.summary: Fixes Responses API tool argument streaming so long tool calls no longer trip the no-progress watchdog and retry repeatedly; repeated no-progress timeouts now surface after one retry.

fcd2231a84eb5ce9cfade2dd568efbd7a613b60b.summary: The system prompt and todo_write description now tell the model to start a todo list in its first response for multi-step work on every prompt profile, restoring todo use with the compact profile.

d093d7eb21aa691b43acb082444602dfdde47270.summary: load_skill now follows a stale built-in skill path left after an extension update to the current built-in catalog entry instead of failing.

0fccaf3e4b55321acc0b7aae35fb969a84ae9bd2.summary: Improves the browser gateway on phones and foldables: chats no longer jump to the bottom, a 600px phone breakpoint, denser touch type, VS Code chat tabs in the shell sidebar, a tab close endpoint, and the VS Code view reopens after reload.

398956888ea9dabf2d772b9870ec4d065ccc98f8.summary: find_and_replace in regex mode now rejects ${N} references with a clear error before any edit instead of silently inserting the literal text and dropping the captured content.

a8db2342595555ee50a0d3c90c0f4e565c2604ae.summary: Background agents no longer get automatic budgets or wrap-up messages; the foreground coordinator judges progress through status and progress-check steering, and explicit budgets only stop a run at their hard boundary.

b2e59b000e330cea1e909ffc73cee7b2e86562b9.summary: load_skill can now activate a readable SKILL.md missing from or newer than the session catalog, such as a freshly pulled skill or one in a second workspace folder, while keeping disabled skills disabled and applying allowed-tools restrictions.

edbbcb5d0a6bc26adfe66411d09a4a769e5dd93b.summary: /worktree and /review in multi-root workspaces now create a worktree on the same branch for every Git repository, generate a .code-workspace file, and open it in the new window, rolling back partial launches.

c59648b0a61817e12982343a076415181f5766e2.summary: Codex retry warnings now name the real cause (such as overloaded 503), retry number, delay and next transport instead of a generic 'Response interrupted' message; retry behavior is unchanged.

4c209c22b8db65c08a9d50a3cf8c27e6a7815e6d.summary: The indexer now optimizes the retrieval store between committed batches during long indexing jobs, preventing runaway storage growth and stalls, and reports optimization failures as non-fatal errors.

46ba4f5c08b443cee38d0bd9b631211f25437c5d.summary: Adds a Free Up Space button and agentlink.maintainIndex command that compact the workspace's codebase index and prune old database history without re-indexing, reporting the space reclaimed.

ff0b9b30e7872d33ae98d5dcb0914f294d589eff.summary: Retrieval store compaction and pruning now get a one-hour lock limit so optimizing a heavily bloated index no longer times out and leaves the store locked and bloated.

8c1af1b7d6da03b6bf5ad37cb23721e694269a42.summary: Index optimization now reports space reclaimed as measured on disk, rather than Lance's prune statistics that omitted old manifests and showed 0 MiB, and logs the store size afterward.

1983bb90e97dd17dbd5a6d6521dcfc0029df7c75.summary: Plugin registry changes that only reflect other windows opening or closing no longer make every VS Code window reconnect its MCP servers.

156fe68c14e6da81ce4ecf23246edc659b63d153.summary: Final status cards now show a text result as the summary when set_task_status provides no summary.

4a2121c935f7912c6a41e79b1f8d6f8f5f667f11.summary: Final status cards in VS Code and browser chat now show structured results (text, review findings, patch, verification) and the full continuation prompt next to the action button, with relay lazy-loading of results.

828e2ae3489eb3a898f8b61bb659a1998706a785.summary: The stale-result error for browser final results now says it is waiting for an updated session snapshot instead of suggesting a retry.

622cc3251015f8a6691bb3bbc82367313b16de63.summary: Final status cards hide the built-in default continuation text and show the Continue action at the bottom-left, displaying a Next step prompt only when the agent supplies one.

e07a975a8a41163dfff349e902d33b779ae5a088.summary: Long silent Codex reasoning is no longer mistaken for a dead stream and restarted by the no-progress watchdog; a bounded 30-minute window now applies while reasoning is open.

16f231565e26396c31880bf3ed973f8efc425925.summary: Hardens tool diagnostics and recovery: bounded MCP crash reconnects with config revalidation, preserved evidence for failed background agents, safe command and sandbox diagnostics, bounded xxd/dyld_info reads, web fetch provenance, quiet update polling, and accurate failed-save reporting.

bc4d4187b8cc800e84906bf048997f3b57031fd7.summary: Read-only network rejections now tell background agents to ask the coordinator for the exact remote data, Codex page-access failures report a bounded cause, and dyld_info accepts bare usage and Apple system image inspection on macOS.

5633aefa3c39f54c53bb7a09d9a9ab35998dccfe.summary: Saves without formatting now close the temporary tab they open in a non-primary editor group so agent-edited files stay in the left column.

221b3295c7eaadca57c7125bfe78fcb4cc1806c9.summary: Browser gateway restarts now finish by closing open connections, so browser approvals no longer fail with 502, and approval failures are shown next to the approval card.

e03a1bb782cc17914bc80fa7420e9cfe9353e380.summary: The read-only classifier now allows dyld_info on macOS system images that exist only in the dyld shared cache, accepting missing paths only inside Apple system image roots.

6a7b1b631b3e80a425636ccd7ceb043b4668a849.summary: Adds an Agent activity UX guide to the bundled documentation and corrects the embedding guide about thinking events being forwarded by the Web transport.

d049bc076229da0166c6db076cd84d4ecb2e2b42.summary: Browser-queued and interjected messages now survive VS Code tab switches and work on unfocused chat tabs, and Auto Continue is now a per-chat setting run by VS Code and shared between VS Code and the browser.

f9ca50d6c09f53b22896edae7ef62fd67842773e.summary: Fixes a race where a late heartbeat could reconnect the browser gateway owner after its lease had been released.

2c783bfb6428e8c1e3aa9f4d5477467efa17892a.summary: Waits for the browser gateway lease client to shut down fully before replacing it, avoiding stale heartbeat or registration responses being applied.
